svg.title: Kafka consumer assignment behavior by protocol
svg.desc: Three stacked panels compare classic eager assignment, cooperative incremental assignment, and static membership. Eager rebalancing requires all members to revoke current assignments; cooperative assignment can retain current owners and transfer movers later. A stable group.instance.id and suitable session timeout may avoid reassignment during brief unavailability, but expiration can still trigger reassignment. The newer Consumer protocol is distinct from classic assignors.
svg.text: Every member revokes its current assignments
before joining the new assignment round.
Keep current owners; revoke only movers.
Revoked partitions may move in a later round.
may avoid transient reassignment; expiry can still rebalance.
Classic assignors differ from the newer Consumer protocol.
Source: Apache Kafka 4.2 consumer docs · KIP-429 · KIP-345
